titulo: The last square into the board
caption:
The last square into the board

Eight squares were in and one slot was grey. The last piece hopped in, and the board was finished.

The last piece takes one minute, and a finished board counts for more than a box of almost.

For whoever sets down the last piece of what they started.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a long table. At the right a three by three board of colored squares with one grey empty slot, and one teal square waiting on the floor beside it. A ink-black block figure with narrowed white eyes walks up from the left, its eyes go wide, it leans in and the teal square hops in an arc into the slot, with a small sparkle above the board. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text stays: me finishing the last piece.
